title: Associate Designer, Furniture - West Elm Kids
note: Associate-level kids furniture design role on site five days a week; asks for at least 2 years of retail product design experience and a portfolio.

facts.summary: Associate Designer supporting seasonal kids furniture lines for West Elm Kids in Brooklyn.
facts.duties: Help category designers prepare concept boards and specs, support product development meetings and presentations, track trends and competitors, and coordinate with merchants, sourcing, vendors and color teams.
facts.requirements: Design degree or equivalent; portfolio; minimum 2 years of retail product design experience; Adobe Creative Suite and CAD, 3D modeling a plus.
facts.apply: Apply through the Williams-Sonoma careers site.
